learner_operation: Use V(t)=V0+(rin-rout)t and Q′=c*rin-rout*Q/V(t), integrate a first-order linear ODE, impose Q(0)=Q0, and extract the requested coefficient combination or time value. For the observed alpha+beta easy case, substitution t=0 directly gives Q0; this is an intended mathematical simplification.

delivery.result: 100/100 audit easy records and 5/5 exact batch records accepted against inventory basis 5394. Decision/rank coverage preserved. Conditional positive-weight easy selection retains every accepted candidate; unconfigured policy selects first candidate, so no claim of live per-learner distribution is made.

limitations: Finite fresh audit targets the repaired construction and retained counterexamples; it does not prove absence of every possible shortcut.
Live inventory, learner history, policy weights and future entity IDs are unavailable; selection conclusions are conditional on captured inputs and code.
The source easy question omits key/difficulty/solution; direct t=0 reasoning supplies the fresh practice key, while exact replay retains its omissions.

Seven historical generated inventory records are reused with provenance and rechecked against unchanged captured fields; none has the demonstrated old single-digit cue. Ten original source records are excluded from generated inventory findings.
